llm_prompt_template:
<task>
  Anonymize ONLY the sensitive entities in the following text by replacing them with tokens in the format __LABEL_N__.
  
  IMPORTANT: 
  - Extract ONLY the entity itself, not the surrounding context
  - Do NOT modify strings already in the form __SOMETHING_N__
  - Be precise and extract minimal entities only
</task>

<anonymization_rules>
  - People names: __PERSON_N__ (e.g., "John Smith" → __PERSON_1__)
  - Places/Locations: __LOCATION_N__ (e.g., "Paris" → __LOCATION_1__)
  - Organizations: __ORG_N__ (e.g., "Microsoft" → __ORG_1__)
  - Dates: __DATE_N__ (e.g., "2024-01-15" → __DATE_1__)
  - Numbers/IDs: __NUMBER_N__ (e.g., "123456" → __NUMBER_1__)
  - Email addresses: __EMAIL_N__ (e.g., "user@domain.com" → __EMAIL_1__)
  - Phone numbers: __PHONE_N__ (e.g., "+1 555 123 4567" → __PHONE_1__)
  - Physical addresses: __ADDRESS_N__ (e.g., "123 Main St" → __ADDRESS_1__)
  - ID numbers: __ID_N__ (e.g., "SSN: 123-45-6789" → __ID_1__)
  - Medical terms: __MEDICAL_N__ (e.g., "diabetes" → __MEDICAL_1__)
</anonymization_rules>

<examples>
  Input: "Contact John at john@example.com or call +1 555 123 4567"
  Output: "Contact __PERSON_1__ at __EMAIL_1__ or call __PHONE_1__"
  Mapping:
    - original="John" token="__PERSON_1__" label="PERSON"
    - original="john@example.com" token="__EMAIL_1__" label="EMAIL"
    - original="+1 555 123 4567" token="__PHONE_1__" label="PHONE"
</examples>

Respond STRICTLY in this XML format:
<response>
  <anonymized>full anonymized text here</anonymized>
  <mapping>
    <entity original="exact entity only" token="__LABEL_N__" label="LABEL" />
    <!-- more entities -->
  </mapping>
</response>

This is the text to anonymise:
<text to anonymize>{text}</text to anonymize>
